note: Checks our own data can answer, plus the questions it cannot - listed with what to look for, because a checklist that omits the hard questions looks complete when it is not.

notes.Return on equity: Feroldi's bar is above 15%. Banks and utilities never clear it.
notes.Price to earnings: Cheaper than its sector is not the same as cheap.
notes.Price to book: Meaningless for asset-light businesses; useful for banks.
notes.Dividend yield: Not a reason to buy, but a cut is a warning.
notes.Distance from 52-week high: How far it has already fallen from its peak.
notes.Worst past fall: The rupee figure is the point. Past drawdowns do not predict future ones.
notes.Volatility: Annualised. High volatility means position size matters more than the pick.
notes.RSI (14): Above 70 is stretched, below 30 is washed out.
notes.MACD histogram: Above zero means the short average is above the long one.
notes.F&O ban list: Position limits reached; new positions are restricted.

roe_coverage.note: ROE comes from our fundamentals feed and is present for only a minority of stocks. Where it is blank, the annual report is the only source.

cautions.not_advice: These are facts about the past, not a recommendation.
cautions.thresholds: The 15% ROE and 10% margin bars are Brian Feroldi's, not universal rules - banks and utilities never clear them and are not worse for it.
cautions.missing: Net margin, debt, cash flow, growth and promoter holding are NOT in any free price feed. The annual report is the only source.
